cohort: Pregnant women and their newborns in the North Shoa Zone, Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, who received either midwife-led continuity care or other professional care.
finding: Midwife-led continuity care (MLCC) was found to reduce the risk of low birth weight (LBW) by 24%.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean was identified as a key predictor of low birth weight.
